standard_prerequisites: the finite-type conditions of Lemma lemma-finite-type in the category WAdm^Noeth
the definition of a rig-etale homomorphism of adic rings (definition-rig-etale-homomorphism) via the completed naive cotangent complex

core_obligations: Prove that existence of one ideal of definition I of B making B rig-etale over (A, I) is equivalent to B being rig-etale over (A, I) for every ideal of definition I of A
proof_roadmap: Let I and I' be ideals of definition of A; commensurability of ideals of definition gives c with I^c inside I' and (I')^c inside I.
Unpack rig-etale over (A, I) and over (A, I') through the definition and the two inclusions, using that the completed naive cotangent complex NL does not depend on the chosen ideal of definition.
difficulty_reason: H2: an independence argument that combines ideal commensurability with well-definedness of the completed cotangent complex.
